dimensions.assessment: Applies to covered digital advertising platforms with large user bases, the Federal Trade Commission, and congressional committees.
dimensions.evidence: a covered digital advertising platform shall submit to the Commission a report

dimensions.assessment: Imposes administrative reporting and data collection obligations on major digital platforms regarding mental health advertisements.
dimensions.evidence: The number and percentage of total advertisements on the platform during the previous 12-month period that were public service advertisements.

dimensions.assessment: The source does not outline federal appropriations or specific economic costs for compliance by private companies or the FTC.
Establishes a new mandatory annual reporting framework for large social media and web platforms under FTC oversight.
dimensions.evidence: a covered digital advertising platform shall submit to the Commission a report

dimensions.assessment: Requires annual reports but includes a statutory sunset provision terminating all requirements five years after enactment.
dimensions.evidence: This Act and all requirements... shall terminate on the date that is 5 years after the date of the enactment of this Act.

missing_information: Enforcement mechanisms or penalties for platforms that fail to report
Cost estimates for platforms to track and compile the required advertising data
importance_detail.rationale: This bill requires large digital advertising platforms with over 100 million monthly users to report annually on their public service advertisements concerning mental health resources. It imposes reporting duties on specific tech platforms and sunsets after five years.
